text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, have you seen this "Number"
magazine?
It did a feature on Tracen's
students.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Their paths to their dreams... as newly
born lights,
racing toward the future.
Just seeing them gets
me excited.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If I made it in, you could read it
one day,
far into the future, and
reminisce about me,
couldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, but it wouldn't be just me. You'd
remember
the others too, as well as all
they saw, reflected in
their eyes. I know
you would.
